Architecture Image Databases

  • Artstor This link opens in a new window
    Resource for digital images in the arts, architecture, humanities, and sciences.
  • DETAIL Digital This link opens in a new window
    Online Knowledge Platform for Architecture
    DETAIL Digital www.detail.de/en is an online knowledge platform for architectural education, teaching and research. It provides daily editorial coverage of architecture, construction, technology and sustainability, in-depth articles on buildings from design concept to construction, and access to the complete digital edition of DETAIL magazine.
    Extensive project documentation includes more than 4,500 detailed project descriptions and over 22,500 images, construction drawings and technical information. Professional search and filter functions enable students and researchers to find relevant projects and building solutions quickly and systematically.
    Research features, interviews and debates cover AI, digital design and current topics shaping the built environment. Exclusive project videos provide additional perspectives and formats for learning.
    Continuously updated with new content, DETAIL Digital is a valuable resource for architecture students, lecturers and researchers throughout architectural education, research and design work.
